notes: Group work has a third way: Group score, adjust a partner. You score the group once, and with Just and a partner’s name above the paper you can change one criterion for that partner only. The rest keeps following the group score, and Use group score puts it back.

Partners with their own scores can have typed notes just for one of them: pick Just and their name above the paper, and the paragraphs you write then are theirs alone, with a blue bar. The rest of the notes stay shared.
